name: iatta-adventuretravel
description: Look at the [Nuxt documentation](https://nuxt.com/docs/getting-started/introduction) to learn more.

scripts.compose:rebuild-server: docker compose build --no-cache server && docker compose up -d server
scripts.compose:rebuild-client: docker compose build --no-cache client && docker compose up -d client
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it iatta-adventuretravel-db-1 psql -U rizkyajiekurniawan -d iatta_db
scripts.db:push: docker exec -i iatta-adventuretravel-server-1 npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: docker exec -i iatta-adventuretravel-server-1 npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: docker exec -i iatta-adventuretravel-server-1 npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:check: docker exec -i iatta-adventuretravel-db-1 psql -U rizkyajiekurniawan -d iatta_db -c "\dt"
